comment: Reviewed from Harvard Gazette, 2025-11-03 (news.harvard.edu) and the building's contact page on 2026-10-17. Only what those pages state; no hours or accessible-entrance claims, which neither page gives.

entries.name: David Rubenstein Treehouse
entries.text: Harvard's conference center at 20 Western Avenue in Allston, the front door to the Enterprise Research Campus. Phone 617-495-8422. Three floors; the main conference room, Canopy Hall, is on the top floor.

entries.name: First floor and cafe
entries.text: The first floor has a cafe in the atrium and is the public level. Opening hours and the accessible entrance are not stated on the sources reviewed; ask building staff.
